overdue.help: Requests past their deadline and still unanswered, per workload.

deployments.help: Latest health report: 0 healthy, 1 throttled, 2 failed, -1 unknown.
Configured capacity of each deployment, tokens per minute.

capacity.help: Capacity in tokens per minute: total, on healthy deployments, and needed.
Capacity in tokens per minute: total, on healthy deployments, and needed.

demand.help: Capacity in tokens per minute: total, on healthy deployments, and needed.

recovery.help: Recovery after an applied plan: 0 awaiting evidence, 1 verified, 2 nothing to verify, -1 unknown.

change.help: Latest change: 0 none in progress, 1 awaiting approval, 2 approved and applying, 3 applied and verifying, 4 verified, 5 rejected, -1 unknown; text names the approved change.

action.help: Recommended action, named by the text label: 0 none, 1 approve the proposed change, 2 no change fits policy and capacity, 3 add capacity (at risk), -1 unknown.

resilience.help: Failover readiness, described by the text label: 1 survives losing any one deployment, 0 at risk (lost and workload name the first loss that leaves no plan), 2 already degraded, -1 unknown.

workloads.help: Each workload where it runs now: 0 healthy, 1 over quota, 2 failing (its deployment failed), 3 not allowed there by policy, -1 unknown.

running.help: Demand of each workload on its configured deployment; negative when policy no longer allows it.

proposed.help: Demand of each workload on the deployment Drasi's feasible plan assigns.

policy.help: Placement policy: 1 allowed, 0 not allowed, -1 unknown.

last-approval.help: Latest approval: 1 applying, 2 applied awaiting evidence, 3 verified, 4 rejected, -1 unknown.
